assumptions: E is a complete finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable space and canonical volume, including dimension zero. alpha,beta are NNReal, 0<alpha<=beta. U or V is genuinely C2; actual Hessian at every point and direction lies between alpha*norm(v)^2 and beta*norm(v)^2.

Every Gibbs law is the actual volume.tilted(-potential). Probability, finite second moments, score integrability, centered score pairing and covariance bounds are derived. No minimizer, finite input moments, partition constant, derivative/score/covariance or well-behaved certificate is supplied.

eta>0 is arbitrary; source eta<=1 is unnecessary for this half. C_eta=(sqrt(2 pi eta)^-1)^d is the actual Gaussian prefactor. V_eta is the literal unnormalized source convolution; U_eta=V_eta+log Z_V, and R_y is the actual selected quadratic tilt of the original Gibbs law.
units.statement: For every observation y and direction v, the actual selected RGO posterior R_y has covarianceBilin(R_y)(v,v)>=norm(v)^2/(beta+eta^-1). The actual source unnormalized Gaussian convolution V_eta has genuine Hessian D2V_eta(y)[v,v]<=beta/(1+beta eta)*norm(v)^2. Source beta=1 gives exactly (1+eta)^-1. Brascamp-Lieb/Hessian lower and the full two-sided Lemma4.1 are not claimed.

steps.title: Use the actual quadratic posterior potential
steps.text: For each y define W_y(x)=V(x)+norm(x-y)^2/(2eta). Differentiate the genuine squared norm twice. C2 and actual Hessian bounds become alpha+eta^-1 through beta+eta^-1. eta>0 ensures positive precision and the lower bound.

steps.title: Identify the actual selected posterior measure
steps.text: Strong convexity derives integrability of exp(-V). The true tilted_tilted identity identifies R_y=mu.tilted(-quadratic) with volume.tilted(-W_y), without assuming any posterior density or normalizer. Apply the new canonical covariance lower producer.

steps.title: Keep the true source unnormalized potential
steps.text: The source defines exp(-V_eta)=C_eta integral exp(-V(x)-norm(y-x)^2/(2eta))dx. Its true normalized negative-log density is U_eta=V_eta+log Z_V, by the existing actual smoothed Gibbs producer. The fixed constant cancels in first and second derivatives.

steps.title: Apply the actual posterior covariance identity
steps.text: Original Gibbs probability is derived, and the canonical Gaussian derivative producer gives the actual selected-posterior covariance identity, with posterior L2 proved there. No Hessian identity or moment is supplied to this consumer.

steps.title: Subtract the covariance lower and simplify the exact constant
steps.text: eta squared is positive. Subtract the genuine covariance lower bound and simplify the reciprocal expression using eta>0 and beta>=0. The exact Hessian upper is beta/(1+beta eta), including the source beta=1 constant.

steps.title: Retain the separate lower-Hessian boundary
steps.text: The source two-sided Lemma4.1 also needs Brascamp-Lieb covariance upper. This packet supplies its Cramer-Rao half only. Generic alpha/beta and all eta>0 extend the source normalized beta=1 and eta<=1 assumptions explicitly. The actual nonquadratic source test checks the full posterior and literal convolution without covariance or curvature certificates.
